name: Wyeast 1056 / WLP001 (American Ale)
description: The gold standard American ale yeast. Very clean fermentation with good attenuation. Used in countless American styles from APA to IPA.

name: Wyeast 1968 / WLP002 (London Ale)
description: Classic English flocculating yeast. Low attenuation leaves residual sweetness. Pronounced biscuit and light fruit esters. Great for ESB and English IPA.

name: Wyeast 1084 / WLP004 (Irish Ale)
description: Classic Irish yeast. Slight fruitiness with a dry finish that complements roasted malts. Essential for Irish Stout and Red Ale.

name: Wyeast 1098 / WLP007 (British Ale)
description: Highly attenuative English yeast. Clean with subtle fruit esters. Versatile for English ales from Bitter to Porter.

name: Wyeast 1272 / WLP051 (American Ale II)
description: Slightly more characterful than 1056. Subtle nut and fruit notes. Great for American Amber Ales and Pale Ales.

name: Wyeast 1318 / WLP066 (London Ale III)
description: Produces soft, juicy, fruity ales. Moderate attenuation and high flocculation. The go-to yeast for Hazy/New England IPAs.

name: Wyeast 1332 (Northwest Ale)
description: Produces a clean, malty, lightly fruity beer. Well balanced for Northwest-style Pale Ales.

name: Wyeast 1388 (Belgian Strong Ale)
description: High attenuation Belgian yeast. Fruity and spicy esters. Ideal for Belgian Strong Golden Ale and Tripel.

name: Wyeast 1762 (Belgian Abbey II)
description: Classic Belgian abbey yeast. Rich dark fruit and spice esters. The traditional choice for Dubbel and Quadrupel.

name: Wyeast 3068 (Weihenstephan Weizen)
description: Authentic Bavarian Hefeweizen yeast. Classic banana and clove balance. Temperature controls the ratio: lower = more clove, higher = more banana.

name: Wyeast 3787 (Trappist High Gravity)
description: Rich, complex Belgian yeast. Fruit, spice, and warming alcohol notes. Used in Tripels and Belgian Strong Ales. Tolerates high gravity.

name: Wyeast 3944 (Belgian Witbier)
description: Authentic witbier yeast. Tart and spicy with orange and clove notes. Essential for Belgian Wit.

name: Wyeast 2112 (California Lager)
description: Ferments lager-clean at ale temperatures (up to 18°C). Used for California Common (Steam Beer).

name: Wyeast 2124 / WLP830 (Bohemian Lager)
description: Classic Bohemian lager yeast. Clean and malty with excellent attenuation. The gold standard for Czech Pilsner and German Lager.

name: Wyeast 2206 (Bavarian Lager)
description: Traditional Bavarian lager yeast. Rich malty character with good attenuation. Great for Märzen, Dunkel, and Bock.

name: Wyeast 2565 (Kölsch)
description: Authentic Kölsch yeast. Very clean with slight fruitiness at higher temperatures. Classic for Kölsch and light German ales.

name: Wyeast 2308 (Munich Lager)
description: Classic Munich lager yeast. Smooth, clean profile. Excellent for traditional Helles and Munich-style lagers.

name: SafAle S-04 (Dry English Ale)
description: Popular dry English ale yeast. Good flocculation and slightly fruity character. Versatile for British ales.

name: SafAle US-05 (Dry American Ale)
description: Dry yeast equivalent of WLP001. Very clean and neutral. High attenuation. The most versatile dry yeast for American styles.

name: SafLager W-34/70 (Dry Lager)
description: The most popular dry lager yeast. Clean, crisp fermentation with good attenuation. Excellent for German Pilsner, Helles, and Märzen.

name: Kveik (Lallemand Voss)
description: Norwegian farmhouse yeast. Ferments very quickly even at high temperatures. Orange and citrus esters at lower temps. Clean at higher temps. Great for quick turnaround ales.

name: Wyeast 1450 (Denny's Favourite 50)
description: Produces full-bodied, rich beers. Great for malt-forward styles like Dark Mild, American Brown, and Wee Heavy.
